description: integrations.sh is a registry that catalogs developer and agent integration surfaces across many services, including APIs, MCP servers, GraphQL endpoints, and CLIs. It also publishes guidance for services to expose discovery metadata such as OpenAPI, MCP server cards, and integration declarations.
summary: integrations.sh exposes three documented developer surfaces on its own domain: a REST API at `https://integrations.sh/api`, a streamable-HTTP MCP endpoint at `https://integrations.sh/mcp`, and an `integrations` CLI; the registry pages say no auth is documented, but public access was not probe-confirmed.
